ModMetaData.name: Forbidden Mushroom
ModMetaData.author: melmeh42
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Forbidden Mushroom: a strange, fleshy fungus that grows in any soil (and in the dark) and yields meat shroom flesh.

Meat shroom flesh is a raw meat. Every cooking recipe that accepts meat (simple meals, fine meals, lavish meals, kibble, pemmican...) accepts it, so you get a meat supply without a single animal.

Phase 1 features:
- Meat Shroom plant: sowable in grow zones and hydroponics, grows without light
- Meat shroom flesh: raw meat resource, usable in all meat recipes

More phases coming.
